description:
I am Dr. Hephzibah Rani Singh from India, with a doctorate and a passion for science education and innovation. We are developing an intelligent lunar mission planning application that helps users compare potential moon landing locations and identify suitable mission dates. The application is based on three factors:

1. Terrain Suitability 2. Sunlight Availability 3. Earth Visibility 4. Mission Suitability

Looking for: Python/data analysts (NASA datasets), UI/UX Experts, earth science experts.
